rot.convert.demos.relogio.1: Attack demonstration: it is move 45, with 44 moves without a capture. Under the fifty-move rule, the rook has to fall by move 50.
rot.convert.demos.relogio.10: The king goes to h7. On g8, the rook would also fall soon.
rot.convert.demos.relogio.11: Check on e4, along the diagonal to h7, and the queen attacks h1 along the other diagonal: the fork.
rot.convert.demos.relogio.12: The king gets out of check, and the rook is left undefended.
rot.convert.demos.relogio.13: The queen captures the rook on move 50, the last one before the limit. One move more, and it would be a draw.
rot.convert.demos.relogio.2: Six moves are left, and only the shortest path fits in them. Taking the king to f6 would cost more moves and give a draw.
rot.convert.demos.relogio.3: Check on e8, along the eighth rank: the black king only has g7.
rot.convert.demos.relogio.4: Forced move: the king goes to g7.
rot.convert.demos.relogio.5: Your king goes to g5: the black king runs out of squares, and the rook has to move.
rot.convert.demos.relogio.6: The rook flees to h1, far from the king: it is the defence that holds out longest.
rot.convert.demos.relogio.7: Check on d7, along the seventh rank.
rot.convert.demos.relogio.8: The king goes to the corner, h8.
rot.convert.demos.relogio.9: Another check, on d4, along the diagonal to h8. The target is e4: from there, the queen checks on h7 and attacks h1.
rot.convert.demos.terceira.1: Attack demonstration: Black to move, with the king on the edge and the rook glued to it. See which defence Black chooses.
rot.convert.demos.terceira.2: The rook goes to f6, two ranks in front of the king: it is the third-rank defence, the one that holds out longest here.
rot.convert.demos.terceira.3: As in the third-rank chapter, the queen retreats without giving check: on g4, it takes g7 and g8 from the black king.
rot.convert.demos.terceira.4: The king goes to e7 and protects the rook. The other replies lose faster.
rot.convert.demos.terceira.5: Check along the seventh rank, and the queen attacks the rook. On d8 or e8, the king would let it fall.
rot.convert.demos.terceira.6: The rook blocks the check on f7 and returns to the king's side: it is the second-rank defence, and now the plan is that one.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.e1: Attack: the black king and rook are in the center, and the rook on d5 is glued to the king. Now you will win the rook from start to finish.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.e2: The plan brings the chapters together: cut the king off to the edge, recognise the defence, reach the Philidor position and win the rook.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.e3: Count the moves: under the fifty-move rule, if each side makes 50 moves with no capture, it is a draw. The rook has to fall by move 50.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l1: The queen goes to e4 and cuts the black king off on the e-file: it loses e5, e6 and e7. The rook on d5 is attacked, but the king protects it.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l10: The rook goes to f6, attacks your queen along the sixth rank and stays protected by the king.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l11: Check on e4: the black king only has d6, and the rook on f6 loses its protection.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l12: Forced move: the king goes to d6.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l13: Your king steps up to c4 and takes c5 from the black king. The queen already covers the e-file and the diagonal up to c6: it only has c7 and d7.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l14: The rook comes back next to the king, on e6, and attacks your queen.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l15: Check on f4, along the diagonal to d6.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l16: The king retreats to e7, glued to the rook.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l17: Your king goes to d5, right next to the rook: it is attacked, but the black king protects it.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l18: The rook leaves the attack for f6 and attacks your queen, still protected by the king.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l19: Check along the seventh rank: c6, d6 and e6 belong to your king, and the black king must go to the eighth rank, away from the rook.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l2: The rook goes to e5 and attacks your queen, which is still protected by the king.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l20: The king goes to e8, on the edge: the cut-off is over. Now recognise Black's defence.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l3: The queen steps out of the attack to f4 and pins the rook: behind it, on the diagonal, stands the black king.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l4: The king leaves the diagonal for e6 and breaks the pin, still glued to the rook. It is the defence that holds out longest.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l5: Your king goes up to d3, on its way to the center, to help the queen squeeze the black king.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l6: The rook goes to f5 and attacks your queen, still glued to the king.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l7: The queen leaves the attack with check on c4, along the diagonal to e6.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l8: The king goes to e5, glued to the rook, which stays protected.
rot.convert.ideia.ex1.l9: The queen goes to c6 without giving check: the black king only has f4. Your king on d3 covers d4 and e4.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.e1: Attack: it is move 11, and there have already been 10 moves without a capture. The black king is on the edge, and the rook on f6 is without its protection.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l1: Your king goes to e5 and attacks the rook, which is undefended.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l10: The king goes to g8, still glued to the rook. The other replies lose faster.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l11: The queen returns to the diagonal, on d5, without check: queen, king and rook on the line to g8. Now Black is to move, and it is zugzwang.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l12: Every move loses. The rook goes to g7, still protected by the king: it holds out longest.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l13: Discovered check: your king steps to f6, the queen on d5 checks on g8, and the king attacks the rook on g7.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l14: The king leaves the check for h7 and keeps protecting the rook.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l15: Check along the h-file: the black king only has g8.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l16: Forced move: the king returns to g8.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l17: The queen goes to h5: it is the Philidor position, with Black to move. It is zugzwang, and the rook cannot escape.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l2: The rook returns to the king's side, on f7, and attacks your queen: it is the second-rank defence, which you already know how to break.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l3: The queen leaves the attack with check on c8, and the black king only has e7.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l4: Forced move: the king goes to e7, still glued to the rook.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l5: The queen goes to c4, without check, and attacks the rook along the diagonal. The black king has to stay next to it.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l6: The king returns to e8 and protects the rook. The other replies lose faster.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l7: Your king goes to e6, in front of the black king, and attacks the rook. The queen on c4 stands behind it, on the diagonal to g8.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l8: The king goes to f8, glued to the rook, and keeps protecting it.
rot.convert.ideia.ex2.l9: With Black to move, it would be zugzwang. To hand the move to Black, the queen checks on c5, along the diagonal to f8.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.e1: Attack: it is move 19, in the Philidor position, with Black to move. There has been no capture since the start, and the limit is move 50.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l1: The rook flees to g1, far from your king. It is one of the defences that hold out longest.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l10: The queen captures the rook on move 24, far from the move-50 limit. Queen against king remains, a mate you already know.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l2: Check on e8, along the eighth rank: the black king only has h7.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l3: Forced move: the king goes to h7.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l4: Another check, on e4. The target is a7: from there, the queen checks along the seventh rank and attacks g1 along the diagonal.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l5: The king goes to the corner, h8. On g8, the same check on a8 would follow.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l6: Check on a8, along the eighth rank, and the queen arrives next to a7.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l7: The king returns to h7. If the rook blocked the check on g8, the queen would mate on h1.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l8: Check on a7, along the seventh rank, and the queen attacks g1 along the diagonal: a fork, king and rook at the same time.
rot.convert.ideia.ex3.l9: The king gets out of check, and the rook is left undefended. Blocking on g7 does not save it either: the queen captures with mate.
rot.convert.pratica.defesa.fim: Rook won: you recognised the defence and broke it within the limit.
rot.convert.pratica.defesa.p: Attack: play White and win the rook within 30 moves. Recognise Black's defence and use its plan.
rot.convert.pratica.err.cravada.1: The rook steps onto the line of the queen and your king, protected by the black king, and pins the queen. Capturing the rook does not help: the black king recaptures, and it is a draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.cravada.2: Do not leave the queen between your king and a square the rook can reach with the black king's protection.
rot.convert.pratica.err.espeto.1: The rook checks along the line joining your king to the queen: a skewer. The king gets out of check, and the rook captures the queen.
rot.convert.pratica.err.espeto.2: Do not leave king and queen on the same line if the rook can check from the other side of the king.
rot.convert.pratica.err.espetoTroca.1: Skewer: the rook checks along the line of your king and queen. The king guards the queen, but the rook captures it and your king recaptures: a draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.espetoTroca.2: Do not leave king and queen on the same line if the rook can check from the other side of the king.
rot.convert.pratica.err.espetoXeque.1: The rook checks on g8 and, once your king steps away, again on g7, along the seventh rank: your king stands between the rook and the queen. It is a skewer, and the rook captures the queen.
rot.convert.pratica.err.espetoXeque.2: With the black king in the corner, do not leave the queen on the rank your king will have to flee to from the rook checks.
rot.convert.pratica.err.recaptura.1: The queen captures the rook, but the black king recaptures: only the two kings are left, and it is a draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.recaptura.2: Capture the rook only when it is undefended, away from the black king.
rot.convert.pratica.err.solta.1: The rook reaches the queen's new square and captures it. Without the queen, Black is now the one winning.
rot.convert.pratica.err.solta.2: Before each move, check whether the rook reaches the queen's new square.
rot.convert.pratica.err.soltaRei.1: The queen ended up right next to the black king, without your king protecting it: the black king captures it, and now Black is the one winning.
rot.convert.pratica.err.soltaRei.2: Put the queen next to the black king only when your king protects it.
rot.convert.pratica.err.tapa.1: The rook blocks the check, protected by the black king, and pins the queen to your king. The queen can only capture the rook, and the black king recaptures: a draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.tapa.2: Before giving check, see whether the rook can step in the way, protected by the black king.
rot.convert.pratica.err.troca.1: The rook captures the queen, and your king recaptures: only the two kings are left, and it is a draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.troca.2: On the rook's line and protected only by the king, the queen can be traded. Put the queen where the rook cannot reach it.
rot.convert.pratica.err.trocaRei.1: The black king captures the queen, and your king captures the rook right after: only the two kings are left, and it is a draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.trocaRei.2: Do not offer the queen to the black king: trading it for the rook leaves only the kings.
rot.convert.pratica.err.xequeOutro.1: The rook goes to g8 with check and then to g7, right next to the black king and protected by it. Capturing it does not help, because the black king recaptures: a draw.
rot.convert.pratica.err.xequeOutro.2: With the black king in the corner, before each move check whether the rook can step right next to it, with check and protected by the black king.
rot.convert.pratica.fins.afogado: Stalemate: a draw. Before a move without check, make sure the black king still has a square.
rot.convert.pratica.fins.insuficiente: Only the kings are left: a draw. Capture the rook only when the black king cannot capture the queen right after.
rot.convert.pratica.fins.limite: The move limit ran out before the rook fell. Follow the plan without detours, along the shortest path.
rot.convert.pratica.fins.repeticao: The position repeated three times: a draw. Each move should squeeze the black king or advance the plan, without going back.
rot.convert.pratica.inteira.fim: Rook won, from the center to the end, within the 50 moves.
rot.convert.pratica.inteira.p: Attack: play White and win the rook within 50 moves, the limit of the fifty-move rule. Start by cutting off the black king.
